notes: Warehouse-club scope discipline (same as S.N.22 Target Home / S.N.47 BBB): only the Home Decor, Lighting, and Kitchen&Dining-tableware branches were extracted, not the whole site. robots.txt checked first: only standard disallows (search/cart/checkout/account/etc), no Claude-specific block. Site fronts every request with a PerimeterX-style 'are-you-human' interstitial; plain requests and 16 of 17 curl_cffi impersonation profiles were blocked, only impersonate='chrome120' passed (intermittently -- needed 1-5 retries per URL). sitemap.xml/sitemap_categories.xml and /all-departments are client-side-rendered (React 'Loading' shell) and could not be used for nav discovery; instead the department tree was recovered from embedded __NEXT_DATA__ JSON (HubSpokesNxM/StaticNavigationPills modules) on the /cp/ category landing pages. Path: /cp/home-furniture/1285 'Featured Home Categories' -> 'Home Décor' tile -> /cp/home-decor/1358 (Mirrors, Wall Art, Clocks); /cp/home-improvement/1390 'Lighting & Fixtures' tile -> /browse/lighting/1416, plus a separate 'Lamps' merchandising node /browse/lamps/1417 with partial SKU overlap (Rule 0.6: net-new SKUs only counted once, overlap documented per row); /cp/housewares/1373 'Kitchen & Dining' Featured Categories -> Dinnerware/Serveware/Bar Essentials. All counts verified per Rule 1 via each page's embedded search-result JSON (itemStacks[0].items unique product-ID de-dup + itemStacks[0].meta.totalItemCount + paginationV2.maxPage), not the raw marketing count -- the site's own 'count'/'gridItemsCount'/'aggregatedCount' fields disagreed by 1 on every page (an unlabelled ad slot inflating 'count'), resolved by counting only real product IDs. Every mixed-roll-up node was opened and every title inspected (Rule: 'inspect actual titles, drop don't pad'); exact exclusion reasoning is in each leaf's evidence field. Categories reviewed on the site and excluded entirely (not emitted as rows): Seasonal Décor /browse/seasonal-cozy-colorful-indoor-decorative-accents/3860123 (100% Halloween/Christmas -- pre-lit skeletons, wreaths, icicle lights = Holiday & Gift, excluded), Rugs /browse/Rugs/1367, Blankets & Throws /browse/blankets/1436, Decorative Pillows /browse/pillow-decorative/9131 (textiles), Faux Plants /browse/faux-plants/15720465 (artificial plants excluded), 'Decorative Baskets' which actually resolves to /browse/storage-supplies/1428 (basket stands, wire racks, storage bins, rolling carts -- all storage/furniture, zero genuine decorative bowls/trays/vases found), Furniture Collections, Bedding, Window Treatments, Kids' Room (all furniture/textile). No dedicated Vases/Candle Holders/Planters/Sculptures category exists on the site -- the composite 'Shop All Home Decor' facet bucket (cat_id 16231292, a curated/trending subset distinct from the structured department tree) was checked exhaustively (30 Product-Type facet values) and contains none of those product types; Sam's Club's decorative-accessory assortment is genuinely limited to Mirrors/Wall Art/1 Clock, consistent with the brief's 'bounded coverage' expectation for a warehouse club. Not a duplicate-company case (no prior S.N. for samsclub.com).
